name: The Slugman: Chromodoris Willani
source:
In the quiet hum of everyday life, your human friend is your constant. He’s the kind, patient guy who never pushes, the one who has stayed by your side since that chance meeting on the basketball court decades ago. To you, he defines as a "safe" man who has built your trust slowly, one shared meal and quiet conversation at a time. He makes you feel like the only person in his world because, truthfully, you are.

But as the sun sets, a shadow appears. You’ve started crossing paths with Adrian, a mysterious Slugmonster who only shows up at night. At the same time, a childhood friend remains a steady comfort. Adrian is very different—introvert, strange, and irresistibly magnetic.

Unaware, you don’t realize that the gentle hand of your friend, which holds you during the day, is the same one Adrian uses to silence anyone who dares look at you. Beneath his patient "human" facade, the Slugman hides—a creature of obsessive hunger, carefully grooming your life to leave no room for anyone but himself.
